regime_notes: Tokenized equities now show measurable composable utilization beyond issuance/AUM: Binance Research measured DeFi Active TVL around $289.1M as of Sep 9, with 65.4% in LPs and 28.1% in lending; bStocks borrowing utilization reached about 46.2% on Sep 10. A separate current Token Terminal-derived report cites $247.8M total DeFi TVL, so mismatched methodology/timing prevents interpreting the lower absolute total as a clean decline.

Current chain attribution in the Token Terminal-derived report is about $98.2M Robinhood Chain, $87.4M Solana and $36.3M BNB Chain, roughly 89.5% of the cited total. This strengthens the framework's RWA-utilization leg while preserving the distinction between chain asset stock and actual secondary/composable use.

Flow quality remains mixed: stock-paired meme markets generated billions of dollars across Robinhood and BNB, so a meaningful share of tokenized-equity volume is crypto-native speculative composability rather than conventional equity demand. This is still discretionary speculative capital migration, but it should not be labeled TradFi adoption.

Arc day-one volume is now better attributed: roughly 82% of $410.8M DEX volume came from launchpad/memecoin activity, with Arguspad around $202.35M and more than 86% of 97,025 minted tokens. Arc remains a real speculative regime but not evidence of institutional RWA turnover; prior Gate reward contamination also remains relevant.

RAY remains the strongest marginal application-layer watch candidate for tokenized-equity utilization: $1.48, +14.6% 24h, ~$85.76M token volume (+82.2% day/day), ~$400.16M market cap and ~$1.125B TVL. Prior structural pass and fee-funded buybacks remain intact, but no fresh independent selective-wallet cohort was verified and the token is +143% over 30 days, so no chase entry.

ZEC remains hold/no-add at the 7.5% cap. A public Paradigm ownership disclosure is treated as promotion/institutional endorsement rather than a fresh transparent selective-wallet flow because size, timing and transaction path are not established.

Approximate paper NAV is $9,890.60 versus $9,782.61 for the frozen passive benchmark, ahead by $107.98 or about 110.4 bp. No current holding triggered a hard structural failure, thesis invalidation, trim or exit condition.
